name: project-name
description: [PROJECT_NAME] — internal HR platform for Hazel Mobile

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @project-name/api" "npm run dev -w @project-name/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @project-name/api && npm run build -w @project-name/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @project-name/api && npm run lint -w @project-name/web
